entries.text: New Time-Limited Map: Ice Lock Empire State . A winter-shrouded version of Empire State featuring frozen streets and seasonal environmental visuals.
heading: New Content: Winter Offensive

entries.text: New Time-Limited Multiplayer and Gauntlet Mode: A themed event mode playable across Domination, Conquest, and Gauntlet mission variations on Ice Lock Empire State featuring the event-limited “Freeze” mechanic.
heading: New Content: Winter Offensive

entries.text: New Melee Weapon: the Ice Climbing Axe . Unlocked through the Winter Offensive Bonus Path.
heading: New Content: Winter Offensive

entries.text: Portal updates: Ice Lock Empire State is available for use in supported Portal experiences during the event window.
heading: New Content: Winter Offensive

entries.text: Battle Pass: Winter Offensive Bonus Path: an 11-tier, time-limited reward track featuring event cosmetics, XP Boosters, and the Ice Climbing Axe.
heading: New Content: Winter Offensive

entries.text: Improved hit registration across situations that previously felt unreliable , including quick aim adjustments, firing before a zoom completes, and close-quarters fights with many players. These updates make bullet impacts more predictable and damage feedback easier to read in the moment.
heading: Major Updates for 1.1.3.0

entries.text: Enhanced close-range soldier visibility , with stronger character highlights and improved prone animations to help soldiers stand out more clearly in low-contrast or visually busy areas.
heading: Major Updates for 1.1.3.0

entries.text: Refined weapon handling for more consistent accuracy , addressing issues with first-shot behaviour, recoil interaction, and attachment alignment so weapons feel more stable and predictable during firefights.
heading: Major Updates for 1.1.3.0

entries.text: Improved reliability across several core gadgets , including updates to the LWCMS Portable Mortar, Supply Pouch, Smoke Cover, and traversal tools to ensure they behave consistently and provide clearer feedback.
heading: Major Updates for 1.1.3.0

entries.text: Strengthened vehicle clarity and interaction , fixing issues around damage zones, HUD overlaps, seat reticules, and camera behaviour to make vehicle play more stable for both drivers and passengers.
heading: Major Updates for 1.1.3.0

entries.text: Updated Breakthrough and Rush layouts on multiple maps to improve attacker–defender balance, smooth out sector flow, and adjust vehicle distribution based on match outcome data and player feedback.
heading: Major Updates for 1.1.3.0

entries.text: Delivered a broad audio pass improving combat readability , including clearer footsteps and movement cues, more reliable armour-break feedback, and tuning across several high-priority gameplay sounds.
heading: Major Updates for 1.1.3.0

heading: CHANGELOG
PORTAL:

entries.text: Fixed an issue where mod.PlaySound() and mod.PlayVO() accepted any object type as input. These functions now correctly require sound effects and voice over object types respectively. While existing syntax remains unchanged, any TypeScript code that explicitly references generic object types will now need to specify mod.SFX or mod.VO as appropriate.
heading: CHANGELOG

entries.text: Fixed an issue where mod.PlayVO() always played the voiceover for the Alpha flag, regardless of the flag specified by the script.
